version.changelog: Initial release — AgentBets OpenClaw Skills series

llm.summary: The skill's runtime instructions match its stated purpose (fetching World Cup odds from The Odds API) but there's an inconsistency between the registry metadata and the SKILL.md about required credentials which should be resolved before trusting the skill.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the actions in SKILL.md: it aggregates World Cup odds from sportsbooks/prediction markets. Required binaries (curl, jq) are appropriate. However, the registry summary at the top reported 'Required env vars: none' while SKILL.md declares a credential (ODDS_API_KEY) — an incoherence between metadata and instructions.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md provides a single curl + jq pipeline that calls https://api.the-odds-api.com with $ODDS_API_KEY and formats results. The instructions do not reference unrelated files, system paths, or other environment variables, nor do they exfiltrate data to unexpected endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. That minimizes filesystem/write risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md requests one credential: ODDS_API_KEY (The Odds API). That is proportionate for the declared purpose. But the registry metadata contradicts this by listing no required env vars and no primary credential — the mismatch should be fixed. Also note the command places the API key in a query parameter to a third-party API (expected for this API), so treat that key as sensitive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Skill is not marked always:true and is user-invocable. Model invocation is allowed (default) which is normal for skills. No evidence the skill requests persistent system-wide privileges or modifies other skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it claims (call The Odds API and format results), but the registry metadata and the SKILL.md disagree about whether an API key is required. Before installing: (1) confirm the skill listing/registry is updated to declare ODDS_API_KEY as a required credential; (2) only provide an API key from https://the-odds-api.com and ensure it has limited scope; (3) be aware the key will be sent to api.the-odds-api.com as a query parameter (treat it as sensitive); (4) verify the owner/source (AgentBets) and prefer skills with a reachable homepage or repository; (5) test the skill in a sandbox environment first and be ready to rotate/revoke the API key if you suspect misuse.
